Undergraduate Admission
Students are admitted to the United Arab Emirates University on a competitive
basis, based on an evaluation of their academic qualifications and within the available
capacity of each college, in accordance with the conditions and regulations set forth
in the official admission policy issued by the university annually.

Graduate Admissions
To meet the needs of UAE society, all 9 colleges at the United Arab Emirates
University have established graduate programs in multiple disciplines. Students can
apply online for the following graduate programs. "Meeting the minimum requirement
for admission to Master and Doctorate programs does not guarantee admission." UAEU
has a competitive criteria for admitting students which takes into account the credentials
of the applicants and where have they been graduated from.

Student Exchange Unit
The Undergraduate Student Exchange Program at United Arab Emirates University enables
undergraduate students from UAEU and partner universities to enroll in subjects at
the host institution for credits, which will count towards their home institution
degree. UAEU welcomes international students from our partner institutions. This adds
to the cultural diversity of UAEU where students of 60+ different nationalities are
currently studying. We offer students an exciting opportunity to study and work with
others while growing both personally and professionally. Our students leave UAEU with
broader horizons, many lifelong friendships, cultural sensitivity and global awareness.
